english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 17(1) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.

english.notes:
Byelaw 17(1) provides that no person shall be in breach of this byelaw;-
(i) where there is a notice displayed permitting access to that part of a tram or tramstop to those using specified conveyances; or
(ii) where the Operator or an authorised person has given permission, and in either case he shall obey any instructions given by notice displayed or by an authorised person.
Byelaw 17(2) provides that no person shall be in breach of this byelaw if he is properly using a baby carriage or wheelchair, except where there is a notice displayed or instruction given by an authorised person to the contrary.
